title: Total-Loss Courtesy Credit by Service Account — Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans
content:
**Courtesy credit.** A Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans plan cancelled for a total loss earns a total-loss courtesy credit according to the customer's service account in the Service Accounts and Repair Orders records. Late fees are counted in a window of 12 whole months: a late fee falls inside it when its line date is fewer than 12 whole months before the effective date (the request date).

| Service account | Late fee in the window | Total-loss courtesy credit (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 or Net 30 | None | 25.00 |
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 or Net 30 | One or more | 10.00 |
| Kessler Owner Rewards Gold or Kessler Owner Rewards Platinum | Not relevant | 10.00 |
| Any other account (Service Guest Account, Kessler Owner Rewards Silver) | Not relevant | None |

**Window edge (hypothetical).** With an effective date of 3 November, a late fee dated 4 November of the year before is 11 whole months back and counts. One dated 3 November of the year before is 12 whole months back and does not count.
